scope: Minimal delivery history compatibility plan only; no source implementation accepted yet
chosen_plan: New fingerprint_profile removes only prepare.recovery_work_decision_refs from a deep copy of original normalized frozen config. All other current config and original frozen bundle/input checks remain.
Profile absent means original legacy full-config fingerprint; recognize only explicitly supported new profile, never guess inverse target identity from a legacy digest.

get/list may produce explicit read_only_history/deployment_matchesfalse/persisted_state views. History has no resume/import actions and does not count as completion in the current owner scope. Preserve old record bytes/hash; no migration or rewriting.
control/_run retain original strict target checks and original bundle/current owner checks; the relaxed read path must not be called from write paths.

Per-record list failure becomes explicit unreadable/reference_invalid with actionsnone, not a global page error or silent omission. active remains failclosed for unfinished/unknown/corrupt records and ignores legitimate completed historical metadata.

For retained complete history, check current bundle references/fingerprints via original read-only registration where available and label missing/changed integrity clearly. Historical summary does not become revalidated native ACK; no owner import/export/POST during read.
minimal_regression_set: New-profile exact refs removal changes neither target matching nor immutable bundle check; no new action/launch during GET
Legacy completed same stored selection shows old1/1 or2/2 metadata as explicit history under changed fullconfig, untouched bytes, noactions/currentcompletion
Legacy/current unfinished target mismatch refuses control/resume/_run even if a prior get displayed history
Different workspace/owner/ledger or changed bundle input does not match new stable target or pass current write checks; only refs excluded
One malformed/tampered/unknown-profile record is visible as invalid but does not hide healthy jobs; active failsclosed for uncertainty
Current exact partial job explicit resume still skips already delivered scopes and rechecks original frozen bundle; no automatic reimport
